section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2) used to assess body appreciation in the present study. The BAS-2 is a 10-item instrument rated on a 5-point scale that measures body-related positive opinions, respect for the body through healthy behaviors, and protection of body image. The section notes that the scale has a one-dimensional structure, is invariant across sex, and demonstrates adequate reliability and validity, with an ordinal coefficient of .96 in the present study.
